exposure: BMI (stratified into significantly underweight <17.5 kg/m², mildly underweight 17.5-18.49 kg/m², and normal weight 18.5-24.9 kg/m²)
cohort: 5229 infertile women undergoing their first oocyte retrieval with planned autologous fresh embryo transfer
finding: Significantly and mildly underweight infertile women had similar live birth rates and pregnancy outcomes compared to normal-weight women after IVF treatment.
birth_weight: Low birth weight was defined as <2500 g.
